versions.subject: Merge PR #4406 from @nasbench - Multiple Updates & Additions
versions.detection:
selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\WinRAR.exe'
selection_folder:
    CommandLine|contains: '\AppData\Local\Temp\Rar$'
selection_double_ext:
    CommandLine|re: '\.[a-zA-Z0-9]{1,4} \.'
selection_binaries:
    # Note: add additional binaries that the attacker might use
    - Image|endswith:
        - '\cmd.exe'
        - '\wscript.exe'
    - OriginalFileName:
        - 'Cmd.Exe'
        - 'cscript.exe'
        - 'PowerShell.EXE'
        - 'pwsh.dll'
        - 'wscript.exe'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: ParentImage="*\\WinRAR.exe" CommandLine="*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\Rar$*" Image IN ("*\\cmd.exe", "*\\wscript.exe") OR OriginalFileName IN ("Cmd.Exe", "cscript.exe", "PowerShell.EXE", "pwsh.dll", "wscript.exe") | regex CommandLine="\\.[a-zA-Z0-9]{1,4} \\."
